newsitem.title: CANADA: DBRS places Trizec unit under review.
newsitem.headline: DBRS places Trizec unit under review.

text.p: Dominion Bond Rating Service on Wednesday said it was placing the senior notes of Trizec Finance Ltd, a unit of Trizec Corp, under review with developing implications.
The bond rating agency said it is putting the Trizec unit's debt rating, now at BBB (low) with a stable trend, under review as a result of the a proposed merger between Trizec and Horsham Corp.
DBRS said the new entity, Trizec Hahn Corp, will have a considerably stronger balance sheet with debt in the total capitalization falling from about 68 percent to below 50 percent.

The agency said the new company will become a global real estate entity with access to a large source fo capital. This enhances its ability to refinance large debt maturities coming due in the next few years, DBRS said.
DBRS also noted Trizec Hahn is no longer a pure real estate play, but includes interests in Barrick Gold Corp and Clark U.S.A. Inc.
